codeReview.summary: Round 2 still fails. The two prior blocking findings remain unresolved in the current repo state: `generateSpeech()` still ignores `providerFallbackEnabled = false` when the Sarvam circuit is open, and the only TTS-specific test file is still a tautological suite that never imports or executes the provider. Git history for the reviewed paths shows no follow-up changes after the original feature commit/review.

issues.description: The original circuit-open fallback bug is still present. When `checkCircuitBreaker('sarvam_tts')` is false, the code sets `fallbackReason = 'sarvam_tts_circuit_open'` at line 180 and then immediately falls through to the OpenAI branch at lines 184-195 without checking `providerFallbackEnabled`. Requests with `client_capabilities.provider_fallback_enabled = false` can therefore still return OpenAI audio whenever the Sarvam circuit is open.

The prior verification gap is also unchanged. This file still contains only self-assertions over local literals/hand-rolled state (for example `const expectedModel = 'bulbul:v3'` at line 141 and `expect(callCount).toBe(2)` at line 421) and never imports or calls `generateSpeech()`. A current repo search for `generateSpeech(` finds matches only in `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/handlers/main.ts` and `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/providers/tts.ts`, so the feature still lacks meaningful automated verification of VAL-BE-014/015/016/017.
